url.description: The URL as it was given.

unsafe.description: Whether the link leads to a known phishing or wallet-draining site.

domain.description: The listed domain the link's host matched (the host itself or a parent domain).

owner.description: The account this address is a verified wallet of, if any.

matchesExpected.description: With expectedDid: whether the owner is that account.

lookalikes.description: Verified wallets of other accounts that share the first 4 and last 4 hex characters but are a different address (possible address poisoning).

source.description: list: the synced open phishing list; admin: blocked by a Krao admin; admin_allow: allowed by a Krao admin (overrides list and seed entries); seed: built in.
